originalTitle: Legendary Nigerian actor Olu Jacobs dies aged 84
title: Our Wonderful Actor, Olu Jacobs, is Now Resting
content:
Hello everyone! Your kid-friendly news reporter is here with a special story today. Sometimes, grown-ups we know and love go to rest. Today, we want to talk about a very special grown-up from Nigeria, a country right here in Africa. His name was Olu Jacobs.

Who Was Olu Jacobs?

Olu Jacobs was a super famous actor. Do you know what an actor does? An actor is like a storyteller. They pretend to be different people in movies and on TV shows. They help us feel excited, happy, or even a little bit sad when we watch their stories. Olu Jacobs was one of the best actors ever from Nigeria. He made many, many movies. If you asked your parents or grandparents, they would probably tell you they saw him in lots of films! People all over Africa, and even in other parts of the world, knew his face. They loved watching him tell stories.

What Does an Actor Do?

Let's learn a little more about actors! When an actor works, they read a script. A script is like a special book that tells them what to say and what to do. Actors practice a lot. They learn their lines, which are the words they need to speak. They also learn how to use their faces and bodies to show feelings, like happiness, anger, or surprise. Being an actor is a lot of fun, but it's also hard work! They help bring amazing stories to life for us to watch. **Did you know?** Actors sometimes have to pretend to be very brave, very funny, or even a little bit scary! It's all make-believe!

Olu Jacobs: A Star for a Long Time

Olu Jacobs was an actor for a very, very long time. We say his career "spanned several decades." That's a grown-up way of saying he acted for more than 60 years! Imagine that! That's even longer than your parents have been alive! He started acting when he was very young, and he kept acting and making wonderful movies for almost his whole life. He was like a wise elder, a kind father, or sometimes even a brave king in the movies. Many of his movies were about important things. They showed what life is like in Nigeria and what African people are like. He helped make Nigerian movies famous. Nigeria makes so many movies that people call its film industry "Nollywood." It's one of the biggest movie industries in the whole world! **Did you know?** Nollywood makes hundreds of movies every year! That's a lot of stories!

Why Was He So Special?

Olu Jacobs was special because he was very good at his job. He made people believe the stories he was telling. When he was happy in a movie, you felt happy too. When he was sad, you felt a little sad. He was also special because he was like a teacher to many other actors. Younger actors looked up to him. They learned from him how to be great in front of the camera. He showed the world that African stories are important and exciting. He helped share our culture and our people with everyone. Olu Jacobs won many awards because he was such a good actor. Awards are like special shiny prizes that say, "You did a fantastic job!" **Did you know?** Olu Jacobs once went to study acting in a far-away country called England to learn even more about how to be a super actor!

Remembering Olu Jacobs

Now, Olu Jacobs has gone to rest. This means he won't be making new movies anymore. Sometimes, when someone important leaves us, we can feel a little bit sad. And that's okay. But we can also remember all the happy and wonderful things he did. We can remember his kind smile and the amazing characters he played. His movies will always be here for us to watch. Even though he is resting, his stories and his acting will live on forever through the films he made. He left a big, happy mark on the world of movies, especially here in Africa. **Did you know?** When we remember people who have gone to rest, it means they are still alive in our hearts and in the happy memories we have of them!

A Message to You

So, even though we say goodbye to Uncle Olu Jacobs, we also say thank you. Thank you for all the stories. Thank you for all the laughter and lessons. Next time you see an actor in a movie, think about how much work they put in, just like Olu Jacobs did. And remember, that even when people leave us, the good things they did and the love they shared stay with us always. Let's keep his memory alive by sharing kindness and telling good stories, just like he did. This is your kid-friendly news reporter, wishing you a day full of happy stories and kind thoughts. Goodbye for now!
summary: Olu Jacobs was a very famous Nigerian actor who made many people happy with his movies for a very long time.
whyMatters: He showed the world amazing African stories and taught many other actors how to be good. He made us proud.

originalTitle: Snapchat 'willing to implement' daily time limits for teens, boss tells BBC
title: Snapchat's Big Idea to Help Kids Play More!
content:
Hello, Friends!

Welcome to your kid-friendly news report! Today, we have exciting news about a popular app called Snapchat. This news is all about helping you have more fun and stay healthy! Can you imagine playing outside, kicking a ball, or telling stories with your friends and family? That's what this news is all about!

What is Snapchat?

First, let's talk about Snapchat. It's a fun app that many older kids and grown-ups use. With Snapchat, people can take quick photos and videos. They can add silly filters, like making themselves look like a puppy or wearing funny hats! Then, they send these pictures and videos to their friends. The cool thing is that these pictures often disappear after a little while! It's like a secret message that vanishes.

Who is Mr. Evan?

Now, let's meet a very important person. His name is Mr. Evan Spiegel. He is like the main boss of Snapchat. He helps decide what new things the app will do. Mr. Evan talked to some people from the BBC. That's a big news place where people share important stories from all over the world. He shared a really good idea that he thinks will help kids everywhere. It's about how much time kids spend looking at their phones or tablets.

What are Time Limits?

Mr. Evan's big idea is to add "time limits" to Snapchat. What does that mean? Imagine your mom or dad saying, "You can watch TV for only 30 minutes!" After 30 minutes, the TV goes off, and it's time to do something else. A time limit for Snapchat would be like that! It would mean you could use the app for a set amount of time each day. When the time is up, the app would kindly say, "Time for a break!" Did you know? Many schools in Africa encourage outdoor play during breaks to help children stay active and refreshed!

Why are Time Limits a Good Idea?

Mr. Evan thinks time limits are a very good idea for many reasons. He wants to help kids stay healthy and happy. Sometimes, when we use phones or tablets for too long, a few things can happen. Our eyes can get tired. You might start rubbing your eyes because they feel a bit dry or sore. Also, if you are looking at a screen for a long time, you might miss out on other super fun things! Like playing tag with your friends outside. Did you know? Looking at a screen for too long can sometimes make it harder to fall asleep at night. Your brain needs time to calm down before bedtime!

Time for Real-Life Fun!

Think about all the wonderful things you can do when you're not on a screen. You can run around and play football with your friends. You can help your parents in the garden. You can draw amazing pictures with crayons. In many parts of Africa, kids love to play traditional games like 'soki' (hopscotch) or tell exciting stories under a big tree. These are fantastic ways to spend time! Time limits can help you remember to do these fun real-life things. It helps you balance screen time with play time, family time, and school time.

Being Smart with Screens

It's important to be smart when we use phones or tablets. They are amazing tools for learning and connecting, but like yummy treats, too much can sometimes be not so good. Mr. Evan wants Snapchat to be a good friend to you. A friend who reminds you that there's a whole world of adventure waiting outside your screen. Did you know? Playing outside helps your muscles grow strong and gives you fresh air, which is good for your lungs!

What Does This Mean for Other Apps?

Mr. Evan also said something very important. He said that this idea could be "an important step forward for the industry." What does "industry" mean here? It means other apps, like the ones where you watch videos or play games, might also start thinking about time limits. Snapchat doing this could show other app makers a good way to help kids too. So, it's not just about Snapchat! It could be a big change for many apps that kids use.

A Big Step Forward!

This idea is a really big step in helping kids grow up healthy and happy. It shows that the people who make these apps care about your well-being. It helps parents too. Parents often worry about how much time their children spend on screens. With time limits, they can feel a bit more relaxed, knowing there's a helpful timer. Did you know? Getting enough sleep helps you learn better at school the next day! Screens can make it harder to sleep.

Time for Fun and Learning!

So, this is super news! Snapchat is thinking about helping you enjoy your screen time but also encouraging you to enjoy the amazing world around you. To play, to learn, to explore, and to spend time with the people you love. Remember, your eyes, your brain, and your body all need a good balance. A little bit of screen time, and a lot of play time and family time! Isn't that a wonderful idea? Keep exploring, keep playing, and keep learning, my friends! Did you know? Reading a book or drawing a picture before bed can help you relax and get ready for a good night's sleep better than looking at a screen!
summary: Snapchat's boss, Mr. Evan Spiegel, says the app is ready to add daily time limits to help kids use phones less and play more.
whyMatters: This is important because it can help kids balance screen time with playing outside, doing homework, and spending time with family, helping them stay healthy and happy.
